notes: Modified cash basis audit. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (p4, Total Governmental Funds); its broad Taxes, State receipts and Local receipts lines are split using the all-funds schedule's breakdown of the same lines (p8, General + Street columns). Business-type from the proprietary fund statement (p6-p7, Enterprise Fund); 'Other income' 11,851 split per p8/p1 into 5% gross in-lieu-of tax 8,441 and Miscellaneous 3,410; debt issuance 138,250 is business_type.debt_proceeds; debt issuance costs are debt service interest (fees). Business-type reported receipts = operating revenues 153,503 + nonoperating revenues 83,119 (no single printed total); disbursements 556,909 as printed on p1/p9 (operating 522,935 + issuance costs, principal, interest). The proprietary statement's Miscellaneous 2,018 = schedule Miscellaneous 1,305 + Operating expenses 713. Balance sheet: governmental from the governmental funds statement of assets and fund balances (p3, totals equal the government-wide 201,540), business-type from the proprietary fund statement of net position (p5); totals from p2. Detail from the all-funds schedule (p8-p9, General / Street / Utilities columns); the all-funds budget-and-actual schedule (p10) is total-only and duplicates it, so not recorded. Read pages 1-10 of 10.
